en: to enter; to be to one's liking (마음에 들다)

examples.en: I liked the house I saw yesterday.
If you like the color, buy that one.

examples.ko: 디자인이 마음에 들지 않아서 안 샀어요.
examples.en: I didn't like the design, so I didn't buy it.
I liked my friend's gift, so I was happy.

examples.ko: 마음에 들 줄 알았는데 생각보다 별로예요.
examples.en: I thought I would like it, but it's not as good as I expected.

explain: '이 옷이 마음에 들어요'처럼 마음에 드는 것이 주어가 돼요. '이 옷을 마음에 들어요'처럼 '을/를'을 쓰면 어색해요. 'ㄹ'이 빠져서 '마음에 드는'이 되니 활용에 주의하세요.

phrases.example: 새로 산 가방이 마음에 쏙 들어요.
phrases.en: I really like the bag I just bought.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 것이 아주 마음에 꼭 맞아서 좋을 때 쓴다.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when something suits your taste perfectly.
phrases.en_equiv: like it very much; be exactly to one's liking

explain_en: The thing you like is the subject, as in '이 옷이 마음에 들어요'. Using '을/를' as in '이 옷을 마음에 들어요' sounds wrong. The 'ㄹ' drops out in forms like '마음에 드는', so be careful with conjugation.
